name: domains
description: Domain portfolio, registrar, marketplace, and DNS management for AI agents. Four surfaces: CLI (domains), MCP (domains-mcp), HTTP API (domains-serve), and a generated SDK (@hasna/domains/sdk). The client uses local SQLite at ~/.local/share/hasna/domains/domains.db (resolved via @hasna/paths; legacy ~/.hasna/domains default until the XDG home is adopted), or the hosted HTTP API when HASNA_DOMAINS_API_URL and HASNA_DOMAINS_API_KEY are set; domains-serve reads and writes PostgreSQL directly (HASNA_DOMAINS_DATABASE_URL), no cache or sync in the service.

pgTestGate.command: HASNA_DOMAINS_DATABASE_URL="${HASNA_DOMAINS_TEST_DATABASE_URL:?point it at a throwaway Postgres; the live-PG gate must not pass without one}" bun test src/server

serve.auth: api-key (@hasna/contracts) — header x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer

waivedAssetInventories.reason: Fixed third-party endpoints the CLI must contact to function: registrar/DNS APIs (godaddy, namecheap, cloudflare, sedo, brandsight), RDAP/IANA (iana.org), DNSBL check hosts (spamcop.net, sorbs.net, barracudacentral.org), and Cloudflare nameserver hosts. Product constants, not a bulk inventory.
Same fixed provider/check endpoints as the domain waiver (registrar APIs, RDAP, DNSBL hosts, Cloudflare NS hosts); each host is a required integration target, not an asset inventory.
